_doc: Revert-verify mutants for RFC 14217015 P1.3 (vault-exodev task 2038636f, req ebbe3db4): NoteToRDFConverter materializes the logical edge of a reified statement whose class is a SUBCLASS of exo__Statement, by a bounded (16 hops), cycle-guarded walk of exo__Class_superClass over class-file frontmatter, run only after the three statement slots resolved and the exact exo#Statement match failed. Each mutant removes one guard and must redden exactly the axes in `expect`; no two mutants share a set (§A147). S3 (negative axis) and S4/S9/S10 are green on the pre-fix base by design — S3 is the negative axis, S9 the unchanged exact-Statement control, S4/S10 guard behaviour the base never exercised. S9 carries no mutant of its own: it is a control of the PRE-EXISTING exact-match path; dropping that loop check is distinguishable only on a stale `[[<uid>|exo__Statement]]` alias (S12), the same input as M10. S11/S12/S13 are green on the pre-fix base by design (they pin guards of the walk, not missing behaviour). `red_re` anchors on the jest failure header (§A104). `tree`/`subject` are placeholders — run the matrix on a copy with the paths substituted (§A145).

M8_own_class_identity_skipped._note: The asset's OWN classes are identity-checked too: an exact exo__Statement emitted as the class FILE IRI (emitInstanceClassAsUid) fails the loop's symbolic comparison and is recognised only here.

M9_any_class_counts_as_statement._note: The walk must recognise exo__Statement, not any identified class: a non-statement class carrying the slots then gives an edge. Written as a prefix test (every symbolic class IRI is https) rather than `identity !== null`, which narrows `identity` to never below and breaks compilation (§A36). S5b/S5c/S5d redden too, and legitimately: the over-cap chain's classes carry prefix-form labels (test__Chain0…), so the mutant returns true at depth 0 — the edge appears and the cap (and its warning) is never reached. S11/S13 redden for the same reason: their asset's own class is identified (`test__Thesis` by its text, `test__Sub2` by its file label), so any identified class passes.

M10_walk_overwrites_loop_verdict._note: Dropping `!isReifiedStmt` lets the walk OVERWRITE the loop's alias-first verdict: a class written [[<non-statement uid>|exo__Statement]] loses the edge it had before this PR (review LOW-1 — the conjunct was wrongly called equivalent). Dropping the loop's exact check instead is observably identical (red only on S12) and carries no separate mutant.
